## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the providing organization as named on a [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md) — the convenience string facet for the card's declared provider.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it where the provider must be a first-class linkable [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) (model that as an agent and attribute it); this is the card's flat as-named string.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:modelProvider`](gmeow-modelProvider.md) as a string on the [`gmeow:ModelCard`](../classes/gmeow-ModelCard.md); promote to a linked [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) on the model agent when organizational identity matters beyond the card label.

### Examples

- ex:opusCard [`gmeow:modelProvider`](gmeow-modelProvider.md) "Anthropic".
